import requests
q='B cell affinity maturation somatic hypermutation class switch recombination variable region review'
r=requests.get('https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi',params={'db':'pubmed','term':q,'retmax':5,'retmode':'json'},timeout=20)
print('PubMed search status:',r.status_code)
ids=r.json().get('esearchresult',{}).get('idlist',[])
print('PMIDs:',ids)
if ids:
 x=requests.get('https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi',params={'db':'pubmed','id':','.join(ids),'retmode':'json'},timeout=20).json()['result']
 for i in ids: print(i, x[i].get('title'), '|', x[i].get('pubdate'))
print('Mechanism summary: Somatic hypermutation diversifies immunoglobulin variable-region sequences; germinal-center selection enriches clones with improved antigen binding. Class-switch recombination changes heavy-chain constant-region isotype, not variable-region antigen specificity.')
